description: This file defines the `Scheduler` class, a core component for managing scheduled tasks in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for creating jobs, calculating execution times, managing intervals, and handling scheduler configurations. The class extends `SugarBean` and interacts with related classes like `SchedulersJobs`. It also contains utility functions for scheduling and retrieving users, and overrides standard SugarBean methods.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Represents a scheduler entity responsible for managing scheduled tasks, creating jobs, and calculating execution times based on intervals within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Scheduler object and sets the associated job queue table.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the scheduler, initializing if not already set.

methods.name: initUser
methods.description: Static method to obtain an admin user for running scheduler jobs, or false if none exist.

methods.name: fireQualified
methods.description: Determines if the current scheduler instance qualifies to run at the current time.

methods.name: createJob
methods.description: Creates a new job instance based on the scheduler configuration.

methods.name: checkPendingJobs
methods.description: Checks for pending jobs that are ready to run and submits them to the queue if qualified.

methods.name: deriveDBDateTimes
methods.description: Calculates potential job execution times based on the scheduler's interval settings.

methods.name: handleIntervalType
methods.description: Processes interval components like minutes, hours, days, etc., into human-readable forms.

methods.name: setIntervalHumanReadable
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of the scheduler's interval configuration.

methods.name: setStandardArraysAttributes
methods.description: Initializes arrays such as suffixes for dates, day and month labels.

methods.name: parseInterval
methods.description: Parses the serialized interval string into component parts for processing.

methods.name: checkCurl
methods.description: Checks if cURL extension is available and alerts if not.

methods.name: displayCronInstructions
methods.description: Displays instructions for setting up cron jobs on Windows or Linux.

methods.name: rebuildDefaultSchedulers
methods.description: Resets and initializes default scheduler entries in the database.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Overrides to create export query for scheduler list; uses default list query.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Overrides to fill additional list fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Overrides to fill additional detail fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view, including interval descriptions.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the scheduler for summary purposes.

methods.name: getJobsList
methods.description: Returns a list of available scheduler job types, including function names and labels.
